description: Buy energy or bandwidth at the Merx market quote. Confirmed Merx funds and API key required; no commission.

amount.description: Amount of resource units (min 65000 for ENERGY, 1000 for BANDWIDTH).

duration_sec.description: Rental duration in seconds on the fixed market grid, from 2 minutes through 24 hours.

idempotency_key.description: Unique operation ID (1–200 characters). Reuse this exact value when retrying after a timeout or lost response.

max_price_sun.description: Optional offered price in SUN/unit. Below-current offers fail; equal or higher offers execute at the submitted price. Omit to use the current best price.

target_address.description: TRON address to receive delegated resources.

name: create_order
